verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a triggers system. Cron triggers wake an agent on a five-field schedule and deliver a prompt as a chat message, and agents can turn natural-language schedules into real wake triggers. This covers time-based automation, but the evidence only shows schedule-based triggers, not general event-condition rules. Outbound lifecycle webhooks notify external consumers rather than letting users define in-product rules that fire actions. Missing for 10: user-defined event-based triggers (non-cron events such as incoming data, state changes, or external events), a rule/condition model, documentation of trigger types beyond cron, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
